solution: The 2080-OF2 has 12-bit resolution, and the output range is 0 to 65535, so 4mA will be around 13107, and 20mA will be around 65535. ... If you write a UDINT value of 65535 to an -OF2 channel in the Micro820 program, the output current signal should be near 20mA. If you send a UDINT value of 0, the output current should be near 0mA. If you send a UDINT value of 13107 (=65535/5), the output current should be near 4mA (=20mA/5).
